title.narrative: Mahaweli Water Security Investment Program Stage 2 Project

description.narrative:
The proposed project will include the (i) completion of the remaining section of the tunnel (about 4.7 km tunnel drilling) and other balance works, including permanent support and finishing works; invert concrete of entire tunnel; dismantling and removal of tunnel-boring machines; connection to cut and cover sections at portals; site restoration; and (ii) construction of open or covered canal or conduit and tunnel with a total length of 68.3 km.
The project will also cover (i) construction or improvement of cascade irrigation distribution networks and the commercial agriculture development (CAD); (ii) support to agricultural and water productivity improvement for selected cash crops, such as land preparation; planting materials; sprinkler and/or drip irrigation; extension services; marketing; and farmers' training and capacity development; and(iii) provision of 'water on demand' to farmers through modernized irrigation systems. These are additional to the original MFF scope to maximize the completed irrigation infrastructure.
